counting_policy: Individual file pages identified by matching prior displayed search phrase, NOT by independently preserved preview URLs or image hashes. Do not claim user-approved exact file pixels yet.
policy: Every user KEEP vote remains attached to the approved in-chat subject and photographic choice. Do not overwrite original approval.

A source page CC BY, CC BY-SA or CC0 tag covers the stated photographer grant; it does not establish a right to reproduce an underlying protected sculpture, painting, museum asset, design, or monument.
No automatic publication, official-shrine photo scraping, or commercial licence purchases. No rights-holder contact by default.
If file subject is other than the canonical Place, keep the editorial KEEP vote as historical preference but block publishing that file and seek a true-location alternative.
Public domain claimed for an undated postcard is not automatically proven; archive versus contemporary display must be distinguished.
Link back to Commons File page and retain exact author, license name and license URL before any release. Check cropped derivatives for licence compatibility.
Any final export must have original bytes, hash, dimensions, legal analysis per jurisdiction, and photo exact visual identity; all left incomplete in this round.
